basis: CFTC COT release guidance: generally Friday 3:30 p.m. ET for preceding Tuesday; historical exceptions below
report_date_policy: 2025-11-11 is not an independent COT report date; the Veterans Day week is represented by the 2025-11-10 report date in the CFTC catch-up schedule.
pit_policy: available_time is bound to publication timestamp. No observation may be used before available_time. No proxy, interpolation, or inferred publication timestamp outside documented normal schedule and explicit CFTC exceptions.
